A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GroundingSuite and contain readable text, tables, figures, equations, and complete appendices. All 13 pages of each version support comparison; Appendices A and B are unchanged.

before.justification: v1 reports original GSEval and GSEval-BBox evaluations, dataset-training comparisons, and scalability experiments in Tables 2–6.

after.justification: v2 retains original benchmark and training experiments, adds evaluated models, and reports a revised automated-dataset comparison.

M1.justification: The GSSculpt localization, text-generation, and noise-filtering procedure is unchanged, as are its component models and the GSEval curation process. Figure 3 replaces an illustration without changing the procedure.

E1.justification: The training datasets, evaluation benchmarks, and four grounding categories are retained. Table 5 removes its GSEval result column, but GSEval remains evaluated elsewhere; this does not remove that task coverage from the paper.

E2.justification: Table 2 adds GSVA-7B and GSVA-13B. Table 3 adds Mistral-Small-3.1-24B, Ferret-7B, and Ferret-13B. Existing comparators remain, producing a limited expansion of the established segmentation and bounding-box comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 6.2 extends the comparison using 100k samples per automated dataset from EVF-SAM to both EVF-SAM and LISA-7B. v1 explicitly includes RefCOCO-series co-training; v2 omits that statement without establishing whether co-training stopped. The benchmark metrics and scalability training schedule remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The automated-data quality ablation in Table 5 now tests whether GSTrain's advantage over GranD holds under a second architecture, LISA-7B, while dropping its GSEval comparison. The data-inclusion and scalability ablations in Tables 4 and 6, and the qualitative analyses, remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental repeat counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Both retain point-estimate reporting and the same description of random 100k-sample selection.

E6.justification: The central dataset comparison in Table 5 is substantially replaced: GSTrain/GranD gRefCOCO scores change from 64.8/65.6 to 28.9/28.0 under EVF-SAM, and new LISA-7B results include 37.6/29.6 on RefCOCOm; GSEval entries disappear. These are replacement results with incompletely matched training descriptions. Tables 2–3 add five model rows, and Doubao's reported overall accuracy changes from 56.5 to 64.2, with multi-object accuracy changing from 62.6 to 85.2.

T1.justification: The gIoU definition and mathematical content in Section 4.4 are unchanged. Neither version contains additional theoretical propositions or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same annotation-framework, training-dataset, and evaluation-benchmark contributions, including the efficiency and state-of-the-art performance claims.

C2.justification: Section 6.2 replaces discussion of relative dataset strengths with an interpretation of consistent superiority over GranD across both architectures, emphasizing LISA's benefit on complex expressions. The broader generalization arguments and fine-grained localization limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 6.2 removes the explicit RefCOCO-series co-training detail, reducing clarity about the revised experiment's data mixture. Appendix B's prompts, existing implementation details, and project link remain unchanged; prompts for the newly added bounding-box models are not supplied.

R1.justification: v2 adds references for GSVA, Ferret, and Mistral-Small-3.1 in connection with their evaluation. Existing references are retained, and the related-work discussion and novelty positioning otherwise remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Section 6.2's experimental description and results discussion are locally rewritten. The remaining narrative, section organization, and appendix text are substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3 replaces a phone labeled 'Stuff' with a cat labeled 'Single' and updates the masks and classifier illustration. Tables 2–3 gain rows; Table 5 gains explicit method/dataset columns and loses GSEval. Table 6 moves downward, causing local text reflow without a document-wide redesign.

improvement.justification: The expanded model comparisons make the benchmark more informative, and testing GSTrain against GranD under LISA as well as EVF-SAM reduces that comparison's reliance on one architecture. Figure 3 also removes an inconsistent category label. These gains are limited by Table 5's loss of GSEval results and explicit co-training information; its replacement scores do not establish same-setting performance progress.
